intervals.note: Year-precision only, sourced to Wikipedia only ('discovered first Z event on April 12, 1989' and 'early-to-mid 1990s' for SLD operation); end year 1998 matches the commonly-cited shutdown but is not independently re-confirmed by an official page in this session. Flagged for review.

cms_energy.note: Sourced to Wikipedia only ('about 90 GeV, equal to the mass of the Z boson'); recorded as ~91 GeV (the Z mass) with approx flag.
cms_energy.quote: The center of mass energy was about 90 GeV, equal to the mass of the Z boson, which the accelerator was designed to study.
